newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Dec commodity futures volume down 16% yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Japan Dec commodity futures volume down 16% yr/yr.

text.p: The trading volume of futures on Japan's 10 commodities exchanges totalled 4,887,513 lots in December, down 16.0 percent from a year earlier but up 1.7 percent from November, the Japan Federation of Commodity Exchanges said on Tuesday. The volume of yen-based corn futures on the Tokyo Grain Exchange was the largest of the futures traded on the exchanges, totalling 1,230,167 lots in December.
